message:
The other day, we were heading out for a family picnic when I remembered to grab our go-bags from the closet. It felt like a small win, but I can’t tell you how relieved I was to have those essentials packed. As we settled down to eat, it started to rain unexpectedly! ☔️ Instead of rushing home, we sheltered under a tree and enjoyed our snacks, knowing we had water and a few games to keep us entertained. 

It reminded us that a little preparation can turn a potential hassle into a fun adventure. Have you had any small wins that helped you out recently?
